title: MCP tool descriptions live in tools.yaml; regenerate two schema JSONs together
answers: Where do I edit the llma-prompt-get description?
Changing an MCP tool description for AI observability
generated-tool-definitions.json out of sync with tools.yaml
body:
MCP tool descriptions for AI observability are authored in `products/ai_observability/mcp/tools.yaml` (entries like `llma-prompt-get`, `llma-prompt-list`, `llma-prompt-update`).
The same description text is mirrored verbatim in two generated files: `services/mcp/schema/generated-tool-definitions.json` and `services/mcp/schema/tool-definitions-all.json`.
A description-only change needs no handler or schema changes, but both JSON files must be regenerated (not hand-edited) so they match the YAML.
The tool descriptions are the docs surface for these tools, so behavior notes belong there.
